itineraries.summary: Maz's structured one-day Asakusa plan from her TikTok: morning matcha/coffee, Sensō-ji and Nakamise-dōri, craft shopping, local lunch picks, strongest matcha ice cream, Kappabashi kitchenware street, free observation view, and an underground bar to end the day. All venues named in the post.

extractions.notes: Maz (half-Japanese, based in UK) is the strongest itinerary source in this batch. The TikTok @wheretofindme account also has Rome itinerary content (cited in sociallypowerful.com roundup with tags 'Rome itinerary', video https://www.tiktok.com/@wheretofindme/video/7355608304799714593), but no specific venues were named in available snippets, so it was not extracted. Follower count kept as given in CSV (486.5K). Note: one browser_open attempt (wheretofindme.co.uk/tokyo-guide) failed with a fetch error, so extraction relied on search-result snippets and TikTok captions.

Caroline Foster, nature/outdoor photographer (later.com cites 816K followers; task CSV says unknown — left unchanged per brief). Content is scenic inspiration (Iceland, Banff, snow landscapes) with 'practical tips on outdoor travel and capturing nature's beauty' per later.com, and Contiki notes she encourages exploring your own backyard. No named destination guides, day-by-day itineraries, or structured trip plans found — inspiration clips, not itineraries, so none recorded. Sources checked: Later 'Top 15 Travel Influencers 2025' (https://later.com/blog/top-travel-influencers/), Contiki 'Inspiring women travelers to follow on TikTok' (https://www.contiki.com/six-two/article/inspiring-women-travelers-on-tiktok/), Elite Daily profile (https://nc.elitedaily.com/news/caroline-fosters-wilderness_addict-instagram-account-is-a-wanderlust-dream-22955472).
